description.narrative: Lebanon has been witnessing an escalation in conflict since early March 2026, following the outbreak of regional tensions on 28 February 2026. The crisis is affecting the country severely, and humanitarian needs are extremely high. Displacement has reached one million people, half of whom are women and children. Fatalities and injuries continue to rise daily. Livelihoods and sources of income for displaced communities have been heavily strained, and infrastructure has suffered significant damage. Amid this situation, the Lebanese Red Cross (LRC) is leading the response through its emergency services, blood services, disaster management and relief activities, disaster risk reduction efforts, and volunteer mobilization. The LRC is also supporting the authorities by tracking displacement and coordinating with humanitarian actors, while the medico‑social sector continues to provide primary health care. The British Red Cross is supporting the LRC in carrying out this vital response, and we are developing this emergency page for that purpose.

This payment is supported by the Disaster Fund, and is a contribution to the Lebanese Red Cross cash response to the conflict affected people. Attached is the co-signed BRC LRC GAD and the DF allocaiton approval.
